entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: A small backwater plane far from Dominaria, rich in mana, devastated by the Apocalypse Chime, setting of the Homelands expansion.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers with a citadel on Ulgrotha, opposed to their rivals the Ancients.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: Rival planeswalkers of the Tolgath; one opened a rift to fuel spells.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: A Tolgath who rang the Apocalypse Chime, was trapped in a coffin, and was freed and renamed Grandmother Sengir by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: An artifact that unleashed a magical backlash destroying nearly all life on Ulgrotha and creating the Dead Zone.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: An ancient Vampire Lord stranded on Ulgrotha who conquered the dwarves' castle and rules the Dark Barony.

entities.name: Irini
entities.description: The Dwarven King's daughter, captured and turned into a vampire by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived in the Homelands, encouraged peace, founded Aysen and was seen as a goddess.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A planeswalker who loved Serra, founded the Wizards' School, cast the Ban and died in a laboratory accident.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A latent planeswalker and Feroz's apprentice exiled by Taysir.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A jealous planeswalker who follows Sandruu, defeats and exiles him, and is defeated by Feroz.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: An immortal who became King of the goblins of Koskun Keep.

entities.name: Ihsan's Shade
entities.description: Baron Sengir's lieutenant commanding a vampire army.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Ulgrotha around 4500 AR.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited the Homelands.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: One of the two planeswalkers who battled on Ulgrotha (non-canon).

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A willow that gained sentience and power over the Great Wood due to Feroz's Ban.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: A state founded on the Northern Plains under Serra's protection, center of learning and healing.

entities.name: Dwarves of Ulgrotha
entities.description: Dwarves from another plane who built New Freedom and Morning Light and were trapped by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Anaba minotaurs
entities.description: A pacifistic minotaur culture of the Kher Range.

entities.name: Great War
entities.description: The war between the Tolgath and the Ancients that ended with the Apocalypse Chime.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: A magical barrier cast by Feroz and Serra to guard Ulgrotha against planeswalkers; it failed after Feroz's death.

entities.name: Dead Zone
entities.description: The cursed majority of the plane that strips mana and life from everything touching it.

entities.name: Dark Barony
entities.description: The swamp lands controlled by the Sengir family.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: The stone castle begun by the dwarves and taken by Baron Sengir as capital of the barony.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A distant plane affected by the Chime's backlash and linked by a portal from Sursi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Ulgrotha became a target.

events.summary: The Tolgath and the Ancients wage war on Ulgrotha, and one of the Ancients opens a rift to another world to fuel spells.
events.quote: one of the Ancients was forced to open a rift from Ulgrotha to a different world, just to fuel their spells

events.summary: The Tolgath Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, ending the war and devastating the whole plane.
events.quote: the Tolgath Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

events.summary: The Chime kills all creatures, and the land becomes the Dead Zone that drains mana and life; Ravi hides in a coffin and cannot free herself.
Dwarves from another plane dig through a planar gate to Ulgrotha and found New Freedom and the castle Morning Light.
events.quote: a colony of Dwarves from another plane dug through a subterranean planar gate to Ulgrotha

events.summary: Baron Sengir, stranded after two planeswalkers duel, slays or undeads the dwarves and takes the castle.
events.quote: they found that all of their kin had been slain or turned into undead by the Baron

events.summary: Baron Sengir captures Irini and turns her into a vampire.
Baron Sengir frees the mad Ravi from her coffin and renames her Grandmother Sengir.
events.quote: He freed her from the coffin, and brought her with him, renaming her Grandmother Sengir.

events.summary: Serra arrives, encourages peace among the nomads and founds Aysen, becoming its protector goddess.
events.quote: she encouraged peace between the various plains nomads and the foundation of the state of Aysen

events.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
events.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

events.summary: Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then defeated by Feroz.
events.quote: Their duel was won by Taysir, who exiles Sandruu to a remote plane.

events.summary: Feroz and Serra cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it from planeswalkers.
events.quote: decided to cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it against further despoilment at the hands of strangers

events.summary: Feroz dies in a laboratory accident and Serra is manipulated by Sengir into leaving the plane; the ban begins to fail.
events.quote: Feroz tragically died in a laboratory accident, and Serra was manipulated by Sengir to leave the plane in sadness and guilt

events.summary: Leshrac visits around 4500 AR and sees a vampire army under Ihsan's Shade, hinting at Sengir's conquest.
events.quote: Leshrac saw a vampire army marching in the night at the reluctant command of Ihsan 's Shade

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir stays behind to defend the plane when Ulgrotha becomes a target of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind and was part of the planes' defense
